rule: For each of six topic queries, inventory EVERY result visibly returned by the search tool. No total engine-hit estimate is used. Merge exact URLs; then merge publication versions by normalized title and authors/DOI. Exclude non-scholarly pages, generic profiles, and explicit topic mismatches using title/metadata. Attempt to open the primary abstract/paper for every remaining distinct scholarly work; classify inaccessible sources separately. Record each decision, access level and mapping. No ranking cutoff or positive-result criterion.
